Chief_Complaint.content: Episodic right-sided paresthesia and weakness described as 'weird symptoms'

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Approximately 1.5–2 months of intermittent episodes of neurological symptoms
Episodes initially occurred about once per month or per week, now occurring several times per day
Episodes last 3–4 days and then remit
During episodes the patient experiences pins-and-needles and numbness in the right hand
During episodes the patient experiences right arm weakness
During episodes the patient experiences concurrent leg weakness
During episodes the patient has transient abnormal gait
During episodes the patient has difficulty holding and drinking from a cup
During episodes the patient has a sensation of something in the throat
Episodes are associated with decreased activity
The patient was asymptomatic at the time of the consultation
